data.description: 【丛雨 · 和室纯白棉被半透雪白薄纱与侧卧蜷缩安心深抚】古朴温暖的和室厚棉被褥中央，全裸的丛雨身上仅搭着一袭薄如蝉翼的半透明纯白薄纱短披风（sheer translucent cloth）。如晨雾般的轻纱若隐若现地覆在她白皙娇小的匀称身段上，精致小巧的胸脯与平坦小腹若隐若现。五百年来孤独守护的神刀剑灵，像只寻求庇护的幼猫般侧卧蜷缩在松软棉被中，小巧白嫩的脚趾因快感自然蜷缩。双手一手护胸，另一手在薄纱下摆深处缓慢而深情地自我抚慰，红宝石般的双眸流下安心依恋的清泪，把发烫的面颊贴在枕席间甜美微喘——「五百年的孤独……只要在你的温暖里……全部都能被抚平了……哈啊……」

data.promptProse: A heart-meltingly tender, deeply sensual anime illustration of Murasame from Senren Banka curled up on her side within a thick white futon in an antique Japanese bedroom at night. She is lightly draped in a gossamer, semi-translucent white silk veil that clings sheerly to her petite porcelain frame, teasingly revealing her delicate chest and slender hips. Her blonde hair with its expressive ahoge pools softly across the pillows as her tiny bare toes curl in pleasurable release. Cradling her fragile bodice with one hand, her other hand gently strokes her drenched center beneath the sheer cloth as tears of heartfelt comfort and liberation shimmer in her ruby-red eyes.
